an10.5:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Ānando bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an10.5:1.2: Dussīlassa āvuso sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.5:1.3: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti pāmujjaṃ,
an10.5:1.4: pāmujje asati pāmujjavipannassa hatupanisā hoti pīti,
an10.5:1.5: pītiyā asati pītivipannassa hatupanisā hoti passaddhi,
an10.5:1.6: passaddhiyā asati passaddhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti sukhaṃ,
an10.5:1.7: sukhe asati sukhavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi,
an10.5:1.8: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
an10.5:1.9: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo,
an10.5:1.10: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an10.5:1.11: Seyyathā pi āvuso rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno, tassa papaṭikā pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pheggu pi sāro pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an10.5:1.12: evam eva kho āvuso dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.5:1.13: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an10.5:2.1: Sīlavato āvuso sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.5:2.2: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti pāmujjaṃ,
an10.5:2.3: pāmujje sati pāmujjasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti pīti,
an10.5:2.4: pītiyā sati pītisampannassa upanisasampannā hoti passaddhi,
an10.5:2.5: passaddhiyā sati passaddhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sukhaṃ,
an10.5:2.6: sukhe sati sukhasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi,
an10.5:2.7: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
an10.5:2.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo,
an10.5:2.9: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an10.5:2.10: Seyyathā pi āvuso rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno, tassa papaṭikā pi pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pheggu pi sāro pi pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an10.5:2.11: evam eva kho āvuso sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.5:2.12: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
